title: 欧盟拟限化工家具：中国稀土在手，谈判天平会否倾斜？
speaker: Kenja Lao

segments.en: Because we just reported that the EU is now looking at potential new caps on Chinese imports in other sectors like chemicals, furnitures.
segments.zh: 因为刚有报道称，欧盟正考虑对化工、家具等其他行业的中国进口商品设置新上限。

segments.en: How is that going to show up in markets? I think that will continue to be a concern for equity investors.
segments.zh: 这会如何反映在市场？我认为这将继续是权益资产参与者的一大担忧。

segments.en: But I think it's important to really take a step back and think about the whole dynamic here.
segments.zh: 但我认为重要的是退一步，思考这里的整体动态。

segments.en: Obviously, the EU can put in more restrictions or trade tariffs.
segments.zh: 显然，欧盟可以施加更多限制或贸易关税。

segments.en: But at the same time, I think China has a pretty good leverage on the legal system table, right?
segments.zh: 但与此同时，我认为中国在法律体系层面有相当好的筹码，对吧？

segments.en: In particular, rare earths. So that's why I think the two parties need to continue to engage and really come to an conclusion in trying to find a new equilibrium when it comes to trade relationships.
segments.zh: 尤其是稀土。所以我认为双方需要继续接触，真正得出结论，在贸易关系上找到新的平衡。

segments.en: All right, thanks. Stay with us. We'll have more with Kenja Lao, Chief China Equity Strategist at Goldman Sachs.
segments.zh: 好的，谢谢。请继续关注。稍后我们将继续对话高盛首席中国权益资产策略师Kenja Lao。
